coverage.rationale: The bot flagged changing ParseListItemFieldValueSet from void to Boolean-returning as a breaking signature change, but the developer explicitly rejected this (thumbs-down, 'Adding a return value to a procedure that had none is not a breaking change'). AL callers may invoke a function-returning procedure as a statement and discard the result, so existing subscribers/callers that ignored the previous void return keep compiling and behaving identically; only removing/renaming/retyping parameters breaks the published contract and subscriber binding. The new entry copies the exact pipeline-validated source file patch/repo/baseCommit for this comment's target range (lines 207-229, including line 212) with expected_comments=[], so no finding is expected or ignored there, guarding the boundary between a true breaking-signature change and a harmless added return value.
